# Tailored Tools

> Kent-based technology consultancy helping small businesses integrate AI into their operations. Founded by James Edwards.

## What we do

Tailored Tools builds AI-powered business systems and helps small service businesses get recommended by AI assistants. We work across three areas: business automation (custom platforms), Agent Optimisation (AI discoverability), and workshops (hands-on training).

## Live Projects

### Performance Interpreting
A family-run BSL interpretation agency in the UK and Ireland. Built the PI Events App (live since May 2026 — 750+ downloads in the first two weeks, 50+ interpreter requests, first bookings already confirmed) so venues and event organisers can request interpreter coverage in a few taps. The wider PI OS booking platform (interpreter database of 379 BSL + Irish interpreters, staff portal, email extraction, integrations) is in progress beneath it.
- https://tailored-tools.com/projects/performance-interpreting

### The Sonic Sanctuary
Built a unified business platform replacing 6 separate tools. Event management, Stripe payments, intro pass system, WhatsApp integration (140+ member community), customer comms, B2B booking, and a public website fed from the same data source.
- https://tailored-tools.com/projects

## Agent Optimisation (AO)

### AO Audit — £247
A scored audit across six dimensions: data readability, service descriptions, pricing signals, trust signals, availability, and AI visibility. PDF report with prioritised recommendations. Turnaround: 5 working days.

### AO Implementation — from £497
Making your business fully AI-readable so AI agents can confidently recommend you.

### AO Audit + Implementation Bundle — £697
Full audit followed by complete implementation. Save £47 vs booking separately.

### AO Monitoring — £97/month
Monthly AI credibility monitoring across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude. Accuracy checks, narrative protection, competitor tracking, regression alerts. Annual: £970/year.

### AO Workshops — available on request
90-120 minute hands-on workshop with live audit demonstration for up to 30 people.

- https://tailored-tools.com/ao/

## Other Services

### Business Automation
Custom platforms that automate bookings, comms, and operations - built with AI.

### Custom Dashboards
Single-login dashboards consolidating bookings, revenue, and metrics from multiple tools.

### Software Integrations
Connecting existing tools (Square, Google Sheets, Outlook, Stripe) so they share data automatically.

## Kent AI Community

Kent AI is a free, grassroots community in Kent for anyone curious or concerned about AI. Monthly in-person meet-ups in Maidstone (next: Thursday 21 May 2026, 7pm, The Bull, Linton), plus an active Facebook group and WhatsApp threads. No jargon, no judgement.
- https://tailored-tools.com/community/
- Facebook group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/1537764381187633/

## Workshops & Community

Hands-on AI workshops for local businesses and teams in Maidstone, Kent. No jargon, no hype - just practical tools that save time. James is part of the Claude Community Ambassador programme.
- https://tailored-tools.com/workshops

## About

Founded in 2025 by James Edwards. Based in Maidstone, Kent, UK. James runs three businesses and built AI systems into all of them. Not a tech person selling AI - a business owner who found it genuinely useful.
- https://tailored-tools.com/about
